This is exactly the input of readout_then_equal_matched_r10 (41.36). For the learned rows the seven step readouts are column-standardized with the mean/sd of the POOLED fit-fold rows of outer fold k (a positive affine map per column, same for every answer): X = (R_k - mu_k) / sd_k.

rules.equal: equal mean of the representation's columns (ct7r: of X; f15/b11: of the answer-standardized columns)
rules.cov_lsml: continuous L-SML fitted on the continuous columns of the scope's fit rows, applied to the continuous columns. f15/b11: calfix_common.lsml_fit (the frozen recipe, no re-standardization). ct7r: tail_calib_common.lsml_fit_scaled(standardize=True, loading_scale='unit').
rules.tail: THE TESTED IDEA. Marks = calfix_common.tail_marks(columns, frac=0.20, tie_aware=True, centred=True): per answer and column the top ceil(0.2 n) steps, boundary ties share the remaining mass, centred within answer. tail_calib_common.lsml_fit_scaled(marks[fit rows], anchor, orient_X=continuous[fit rows], standardize=True, loading_scale='unit') (the Step 443 input contract; without it K collapses to 2). The weights are applied to the continuous columns (continuous @ w), as in the frozen V2/V3 tail rows.
rules.votes: control: the same tail weights applied to the standardized marks themselves (marks @ (w / fit_sd); differs from standardized-marks @ w by a global constant removed by answer-z). Checks whether the continuous application is what helps.
rules.part_equal: control: equal weight per group discovered by the tail fit, equal within group (extgen partition_equal), applied to the continuous columns. Checks whether the learned weights add anything beyond the learned partition.

extra_rows.ct7r_leader: readout_then_equal_matched_r10 replayed exactly (mean of the unstandardized readouts R_k, then answer-z): the ProcessBench leader row

fit_scopes.pooled: fit rows = all steps of the fit-fold answers (PB+PRMB), as every earlier tail run; row names without suffix
fit_scopes.pb: NEW: fit rows = steps of the fit-fold PROCESSBENCH answers only; suffix '_pb'. Applies to cov_lsml, tail, votes, part_equal. The ct7r token standardizer and the ct7r column standardization stay on the pooled fit folds (identical representation in both scopes); only the weight-fitting rows change.

endpoints.primary: pb_sla_macro8: first-error hit of the within-answer argmax (first step within 8 eps of the maximum, calfix_evaluate rule) on the 4,442 erroneous PB answers, macro over 8 cells. Isolates the effect of the weights on localization; comparable with every earlier row.
endpoints.secondary: pb_f1_q80: official ProcessBench F1 under the official PRM protocol: threshold tau = q80 of the model's pooled (PB+PRMB) calibration-fold scores (the label-free P1 threshold of the PRMScore contract), predicted first error = first step with score >= tau, none -> 'no error'. Per cell F1 = harmonic mean of accuracy on erroneous answers (prediction == first error) and accuracy on clean answers (prediction == no error); macro over 8 cells. Measures weights and decision rule together.

descriptive.pb_f1_common_gate: the project's standing PB F1 (cvf_v2.scoring.pb_metrics): the frozen CT7 gate (CT7_DEV_SCORES.npz 'gate', identical for every row) decides which answers are flagged, np.argmax locates the step. Differences between rows come from the locator only. Replay: CT7 = 0.41188745848863717.
descriptive.pb_f1_label: LABEL-USING PANEL: tau chosen from the 50 pooled calibration-fold quantiles 0.50..0.99 by the calibration fold's PB macro F1 (calibration labels only), applied to the evaluation fold. Same access for every row; reported separately.
descriptive.prmscore: PRMBench PRMScore P1/P1b/P2 and within-answer AUC from calfix_evaluate.evaluate (unchanged frozen evaluator). PRMScore P1 is the GUARD: Holm over the same 10 primary contrasts.

descriptive_contrasts_rule: for each representation r: r_tail vs r_votes, r_tail vs r_part_equal, r_tail_pb vs r_equal, r_tail_pb vs r_cov_lsml_pb, r_cov_lsml_pb vs r_cov_lsml, r_tail_pb vs r_votes_pb, r_tail_pb vs r_part_equal_pb, r_tail vs ct7; plus ct7r_equal vs ct7r_leader (scaling bridge), ct7r_leader vs ct7, ct7r_tail vs f15_tail, ct7r_tail_pb vs ct7r_leader
statistics: paired source-group bootstrap, 20,000 multinomial draws. SLA and PRMScore/within-AUC from calfix_evaluate.evaluate (seed 20260924; SLA draws over the source groups of the erroneous PB answers). F1 endpoints: draws over the source groups of ALL 6,800 PB answers (seed 20260927), per-cell F1 recomputed from the resampled counts in each draw. Two-sided bootstrap p = min(1, 2 min(P(d<=0), P(d>=0))). Holm over the 10 primary contrasts separately for the primary endpoint (SLA), the secondary endpoint (F1 q80) and the guard (PRMScore P1).

decision_rule: The tail rule advances as a ProcessBench candidate on a representation only if (i) tail beats matched equal on pb_sla_macro8 with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 over the 10 primary contrasts, and (ii) its PRMScore P1 is not below matched equal with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05. On ct7r it must also be compared with the leader row (contrast 4); a gain over ct7r_equal that does not exceed the leader is reported as such. The PB-only scope advances only if its contrast vs the pooled fit is positive with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 on SLA. Anything else is reported as no established gain. The F1 endpoints do not override the primary decision; a disagreement between SLA and F1 is reported.
